audit.why: Melee bruiser whose lane strength is tentacle setup, not raw stats. Aatrox wins in open ground; Illaoi wins inside her nest with Test of Spirit landed.
Leap of Faith (R) is 120/95/70 and spawns a tentacle per champion hit, and it grounds — inside her nest that is an unwinnable 1v1. Existing level-6 and first-item text already say this.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Leap of Faith grounds, which shuts off Umbral Dash — that is what traps you in the nest, and the reason to leave the zone the moment she leaps. Harsh Lesson (W, 4s flat) is her dash and auto reset; Infernal Chains grounds it.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Illaoi. Infernal Chains (W) grounds — land it and Harsh Lesson (W, 4s flat) cannot leap her onto you, so hold it for her step-up, not the poke. Leap of Faith (R) also grounds: once it lands your Umbral Dash is dead, so leave the tentacle zone before she casts rather than dashing after.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Illaoi. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive Leap of Faith — never burn it for a single Q.

notes: _missing/aatrox.json flags Leap of Faith as 'untargetable'. Riot's own description says nothing about untargetability — it is a damage-and-spawn ability that grounds. Treated the grounding as the real interaction and ignored the untargetable flag as a tooltip-parsing misfire, per the kit-file rule.
